info.name: JFrog Xray REST API
info.description:
API for vulnerability scanning, license compliance, and impact analysis. JFrog Xray provides universal software composition analysis (SCA) that natively integrates with Artifactory to scan artifacts for known vulnerabilities, license compliance violations, and operational risks.

Contact Support:
 Name: JFrog
